item.title: Family's hurt as killer of GAA star set for release
item.description: The family of the late Ciaran Woods have spoken of a deep sense of “frustration” and “disillusionment” with the legal system.

item.title: Annual Boxing Day Meet sees horses and hunters create a colourful sight
item.description: Fermanagh Harriers once again held a very successful Boxing Day meet, with the annual event drawing plenty of onlookers as the participants passed through Enniskillen shortly after noon.

item.title: Emergency services attend New Year’s Day incident
item.description: Emergency services are this morning (January 1) attending the scene of a road traffic collision.

item.title: Kelly Lynch: New forensic report shows family concerns were 'justified', say family
item.description: A grieving mother has said that the findings of a new forensic pathology report into her daughter's death confirm her concerns that the case was not properly investigated.

item.title: Jonathan Pinnick: The role farmers play in helping wildlife this winter
item.description: With the long, sunny days of summer but a distant memory, and summer migrants (human and feathered) long since departed for warmer climes, you could be forgiven for thinking that now would be a quiet time for birds and other wildlife in our countryside

item.title: Breeders praised for producing quality stock at multi-breed calf show
item.description: A tremendous turnout of calves were recently presented for judge Victor Chestnutt at the Fermanagh Pedigree Breeders Calf Show at the Ulster Farmers’ Mart Exhibition Centre, Enniskillen.

item.title: Patient speaks out over corridor care crisis in A&E departments
item.description: A woman who had to lie on the floor of the A&E department at South West Acute Hospital (SWAH) to get relief has said it is “ridiculous” that people in Northern Ireland are treated in hospital corridors compared with elsewhere in the UK.

item.title: Fermanagh UFU breakfast raises funds for Rural Support
item.description: A charity Christmas breakfast held at Enniskillen Mart has raised funds for Rural Support, supporting farmers and rural families during the festive period.

item.title: Community in mourning following passing of Fermanagh woman
item.description: The Fermanagh community is in mourning following the death of Wilma Swindle.

item.title: Sadness following death of respected Fermanagh motorsport figure
item.description: Warm tributes have been paid following the death of a respected Fermanagh motorsport figure, Mervyn Johnston.
